description: Original provisional geometric construction for a flat short-sleeve T-shirt block.
sleeveOpeningDefinition: half of the two-segment developed sleeve hem path, whose full seam path is twice this flat width
construction: full-width front and back panels; cubic armholes and asymmetric front/back neckline depths; cubic two-part sleeve cap solved to 1.03 times paired armhole seams; joined sleeve underarms; one-piece neckband split into front and back attachment lengths at 0.9 ratio
